en: A colorized vintage postcard depicting a scenic view across a water body, reflecting a mix of ornate European buildings. The most prominent landmark in the center is a church with onion-shaped domes, likely Orthodox, set among grand townhouses and decorated facades. The text 'KARLSBAD Westend' appears at the top left, and in the bottom right is printed 'Handkolorierte Künstlerkarte.' There is also a small sign that reads 'NEU VERSAILLES'.
